after.text:
@startuml
@layout schema=1 renderer="archuml-visual-editor"
node "__initial__0" x=82 y=30
node "Idle" x=30 y=101
node "Busy" x=30 y=204
node "Done" x=30 y=307
node "__final__0" x=79 y=412
edge "edge-2" points="90,252 30,252 30,307 90,307"
@endlayout
[*] --> Idle
Idle --> Busy : start
Busy --> Done : finish
Done --> [*]
@enduml

uml-pg-status.text: Drag a highlighted element. Tab to focus, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "Relation — Busy → Done":
  - heading "Relation — Busy → Done" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Type
  - combobox "Type":
    - option "Transition" [selected]
  - text: Source endpoint
  - combobox "Source endpoint":
    - option "__initial__0 - Initial pseudostate"
    - option "Idle"
    - option "Busy" [selected]
    - option "Done"
    - option "__final__0 - Final pseudostate"
  - text: Target endpoint

    - option "__initial__0 - Initial pseudostate"

    - option "Busy"
    - option "Done" [selected]
    - option "__final__0 - Final pseudostate"
  - text: Label
  - textbox "Label": finish
  - button "Invert direction"
  - paragraph: Drag a line segment to reroute, or press Delete to remove this relation.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
